title: [home-assistant/core] Fix issue #177183: Nuki integration lock entity fails to register due to non-string unique_id
description:
Fix GitHub issue #177183 in home-assistant/core:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/177183

Repo:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core

Target:
Ship a real upstream code fix for the Nuki integration bug where the lock entity fails to register because unique_id is not a string.

Required deliverables:
- A real upstream code change against home-assistant/core.

- Testing notes describing what you validated.

- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
